Stop trusting a key server or a public key

Stop trusting a linked key server (--key-server, the ID that rp maven keystore list
shows) or a public key (--public-key). Give exactly one. Artifacts signed only
with keys from there no longer verify.

rp asks for confirmation on a terminal. In a script pass --yes; with --no-input
or without a terminal, and no --yes, the command exits 2 and removes nothing.

```
rp maven keystore remove <repo> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --key-server string   ID of a linked key server
      --public-key string   ID of a trusted public key
```
